About

I'm an AI/ML research enthusiast who lives at the intersection of biology and computation — turning machine learning, NLP and computer vision into solutions for real clinical and business problems, from DNA-based disease prediction to sentiment analysis and diagnostic imaging.

As a Junior Research Fellow at SISTec, I contribute to a public-domain EHR application that fuses machine learning and blockchain for DNA-based disease identification and medication recommendation — preparing datasets, running experiments and co-authoring research along the way.
